name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, champion. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Karolek in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
narrative.offerRewardText: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
